panels.description: The continuous time the modem has been powered on and running since its last reboot.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.pulled_at AS time,
  ci.system_uptime_seconds AS "Uptime"
FROM customer_status_connection_info ci
JOIN pull p ON p.id = ci.pull_id
ORDER BY p.pulled_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Modem uptime

panels.description: The locked channel count divided by 32 expected downstream channels and 4 expected upstream channels.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_pull AS (
  SELECT id, pulled_at
  FROM pull
  ORDER BY pulled_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  p.pulled_at AS time,
  'Downstream' AS metric,
  LEAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.lock_status = 'Locked') / 32.0, 1) AS value
FROM latest_pull p
LEFT JOIN downstream_channel d
  ON d.pull_id = p.id AND d.pulled_at = p.pulled_at
GROUP BY p.pulled_at
UNION ALL
SELECT
  p.pulled_at AS time,
  'Upstream' AS metric,
  LEAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.lock_status = 'Locked') / 4.0, 1) AS value
FROM latest_pull p
LEFT JOIN upstream_channel u
  ON u.pull_id = p.id AND u.pulled_at = p.pulled_at
GROUP BY p.pulled_at;

panels.title: Channel bonding

panels.description: The elapsed time since the collector stored the newest modem sample.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  now() AS time,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - MAX(pulled_at)) AS "Sample age"
FROM pull;

panels.title: Telemetry age

panels.description: The newest pull must report six healthy modem status fields.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_pull AS (
  SELECT id, pulled_at
  FROM pull
  ORDER BY pulled_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  p.pulled_at AS time,
  (ci.network_access IS DISTINCT FROM 'Allowed')::int AS "Network access",
  (ss.connectivity_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'OK')::int AS "Connectivity",
  (ss.boot_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'OK')::int AS "Boot",
  (ss.config_file_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'OK')::int AS "Configuration",
  (ss.security_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Enabled')::int AS "Security",
  (ds.internet_connection_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Connected')::int AS "Internet"
FROM latest_pull p
LEFT JOIN customer_status_connection_info ci ON ci.pull_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN customer_status_startup_sequence ss ON ss.pull_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN arris_device_status ds ON ds.pull_id = p.id;

panels.title: Modem status

panels.description: The modem could not repair these codewords. The total line preserves the highest sampled rate in each display bucket.

targets.rawSql:
WITH deltas AS (
  SELECT
    pulled_at AS time,
    channel_id,
    GREATEST(
      uncorrectable_count - LAG(uncorrectable_count) OVER (
        PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY pulled_at
      ),
      0
    ) AS count_delta,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      pulled_at - LAG(pulled_at) OVER (
        PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY pulled_at
      )
    )) AS seconds_delta
  FROM downstream_channel
  WHERE pulled_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz - interval '30 minutes' AND ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
), rates AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    channel_id,
    count_delta / NULLIF(seconds_delta, 0) * 60.0 AS rate
  FROM deltas
  WHERE time >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz AND seconds_delta > 0
), totals AS (
  SELECT time, SUM(rate) AS rate
  FROM rates
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT
  time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, time) AS time,
  'Channel ' || channel_id::text AS metric,
  MAX(rate) AS value
FROM rates
GROUP BY 1, channel_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
  time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, time) AS time,
  'All channels total' AS metric,
  MAX(rate) AS value
FROM totals
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: QAM corrected codewords per minute

panels.description: OFDM correction rates use a different scale from QAM rates. A separate panel keeps both patterns visible.

targets.rawSql:
WITH deltas AS (
  SELECT
    pulled_at AS time,
    channel_id,
    GREATEST(
      corrected_count - LAG(corrected_count) OVER (
        PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY pulled_at
      ),
      0
    ) AS count_delta,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      pulled_at - LAG(pulled_at) OVER (
        PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY pulled_at
      )
    )) AS seconds_delta
  FROM downstream_channel
  WHERE modulation <> 'QAM256'
    AND pulled_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz - interval '30 minutes' AND ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
)
SELECT
  time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, time) AS time,
  'Channel ' || channel_id::text AS metric,
  MAX(count_delta / NULLIF(seconds_delta, 0) * 60.0) AS value
FROM deltas
WHERE time >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz AND seconds_delta > 0
GROUP BY 1, channel_id
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: OFDM corrected codewords per minute

panels.description: QAM downstream power near 0 dBmV is best. Values outside -10 to 10 dBmV indicate a likely signal-path problem.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, pulled_at) AS time,
    channel_id,
    power_dbmv
  FROM downstream_channel
  WHERE modulation = 'QAM256' AND $__timeFilter(pulled_at)
)
SELECT
  time,
  'Channel ' || channel_id::text AS metric,
  AVG(power_dbmv) AS value
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY time, channel_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
  time,
  'QAM channel average' AS metric,
  AVG(power_dbmv) AS value
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time, metric;

panels.title: Downstream QAM power

panels.description: QAM signal-to-noise ratio measures signal quality. Values below 33 dB indicate substantial noise and increased error risk.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, pulled_at) AS time,
    channel_id,
    snr_db
  FROM downstream_channel
  WHERE modulation = 'QAM256' AND $__timeFilter(pulled_at)
)
SELECT
  time,
  'Channel ' || channel_id::text AS metric,
  MIN(snr_db) AS value
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY time, channel_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
  time,
  'QAM channel minimum' AS metric,
  MIN(snr_db) AS value
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time, metric;

panels.title: Downstream QAM SNR

panels.description: Each line shows the last downstream frequency in each display bucket. Frequency changes usually follow provider maintenance.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, pulled_at) AS time,
  'Channel ' || channel_id::text AS metric,
  last(frequency_hz, pulled_at) AS value
FROM downstream_channel
WHERE $__timeFilter(pulled_at)
GROUP BY 1, channel_id
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Latest upstream channels

panels.description: The minimum present and locked channel counts in each display bucket. Expected lines show the normal channel inventory.

targets.rawSql:
WITH pulls AS (
  SELECT id, pulled_at
  FROM pull
  WHERE $__timeFilter(pulled_at)
), downstream_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.pulled_at,
    COUNT(d.channel_id) AS present_count,
    COUNT(d.channel_id) FILTER (WHERE d.lock_status = 'Locked') AS locked_count
  FROM pulls p
  LEFT JOIN downstream_channel d
    ON d.pull_id = p.id AND d.pulled_at = p.pulled_at
  GROUP BY p.id, p.pulled_at
), upstream_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.pulled_at,
    COUNT(u.channel_id) AS present_count,
    COUNT(u.channel_id) FILTER (WHERE u.lock_status = 'Locked') AS locked_count
  FROM pulls p
  LEFT JOIN upstream_channel u
    ON u.pull_id = p.id AND u.pulled_at = p.pulled_at
  GROUP BY p.id, p.pulled_at
), counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.pulled_at,
    d.present_count AS downstream_present,
    d.locked_count AS downstream_locked,
    u.present_count AS upstream_present,
    u.locked_count AS upstream_locked
  FROM downstream_counts d
  JOIN upstream_counts u USING (id, pulled_at)
)
SELECT time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, pulled_at) AS time, 'Downstream present' AS metric, MIN(downstream_present) AS value FROM counts GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, pulled_at), 'Downstream locked', MIN(downstream_locked) FROM counts GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, pulled_at), 'Downstream expected', 32 FROM counts GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, pulled_at), 'Upstream present', MIN(upstream_present) FROM counts GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, pulled_at), 'Upstream locked', MIN(upstream_locked) FROM counts GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT time_bucket('$resolution'::interval, pulled_at), 'Upstream expected', 4 FROM counts GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Channel bonding history

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  first_observed_at AS "Observed",
  timestamp_at AS "Modem time",
  CASE level
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Emergency'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Alert'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Error'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Warning'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Notice'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Informational'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Debug'
    ELSE level::text
  END AS "Level",
  message AS "Message"
FROM log_entry
WHERE $__timeFilter(first_observed_at)
  AND message NOT LIKE 'Successful LAN WebGUI login from %'
ORDER BY first_observed_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

panels.description: The newest modem events by collection time. The query also shows modem time and excludes routine collector login messages.
panels.title: Modem events

panels.description: The public IP address reported by each modem pull in the selected range. Colors follow each IP's first observation in retained history and repeat after ten distinct IPs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.pulled_at AS time,
  'Public IP' AS metric,
  oi.ip AS state
FROM own_ip oi
JOIN pull p ON p.id = oi.pull_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.pulled_at)
ORDER BY p.pulled_at;

WITH addresses AS (
  SELECT
    oi.ip,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY min(p.pulled_at), oi.ip) - 1 AS color_index
  FROM own_ip oi
  JOIN pull p ON p.id = oi.pull_id
  WHERE oi.ip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oi.ip
), palette AS (
  SELECT ARRAY[
    '#4E79A7', '#F28E2B', '#E15759', '#76B7B2', '#59A14F',
    '#EDC948', '#B07AA1', '#FF9DA7', '#9C755F', '#BAB0AC'
  ] AS colors
)
SELECT
  ip AS "Value",
  ip AS "Text",
  colors[(color_index % cardinality(colors) + 1)::integer] AS "Color"
FROM addresses
CROSS JOIN palette
ORDER BY color_index;
